review_text: Delivery took 6 days to reach Clifton. Product is premium, but courier service was terribly slow.
The aluminum laptop stand is flawless. Solid build, perfect ergonomics for daily office use.
Tried to order 5 keyboards for our team, but the keyboard has been out of stock since the start of the month.
Support team answered my queries regarding USB-C hub compatibility within 10 minutes.
Good sound, but the headset gets uncomfortable after a few hours.
